newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning on yen, Dow.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning on yen, Dow.

text.p: Tokyo stocks declined in early morning trade on Monday, discouraged by the yen's brief jump against the dollar and a slide in U.S. stocks on Friday. But trade was generally slow ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee's policy-setting meeting on Tuesday, brokers said.
At 0011 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average lost 103.11 points or 0.51 percent to trade at 20,221.62. Its June futures fell 70 points to 20,300.
